evidence.notes: A 2026-11-22 survey of nine provider surfaces found one that reports a per-call charge (OpenRouter). Contract 1.x labelled every amount as billed, so list-price estimates were indistinguishable from charges and unknown cost could not be stated.

changes.description: `cost.basis` is required: provider_reported, list_price, local_measured or unknown.
`cost.amount` is the cost under `basis` (no longer always billed) and is null exactly when `basis` is unknown.
Envelopes state the contract version they follow, separately from `system_version`.

migration.guide: Add `contract_version: "2.0.0"`; add `cost.basis` (use `list_price` for usage times a rate card, `provider_reported` only for charges the provider returned); turn a string `rate_card` into `{source, retrieved_at}`; add `basis` to each `breakdown` item; bump `system_version` to major 2.
